result.question: How did Uzziah follow his father Amaziah’s example?

readings.answer: By doing what was right in the eyes of the LORD.
readings.support: he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done

assessments.reason: Verse 26:4 states, “he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done,” matching the reading exactly.

result.reason: The passage explicitly says Uzziah did what was right in the LORD’s eyes, as his father Amaziah had done.
